data.one_liner: Customizable Flutter widgets for creating and selecting chips in forms
data.what_it_does: The package offers two libraries: one for turning user text input into chips and another for selecting predefined chips. It supports single‑selection, multi‑selection, pre‑selected chips and full visual customization of each chip.
use_when: You need an input field that turns typed text into selectable chips
You want a selectable chip list with optional single‑select or pre‑selected items
You require full control over chip appearance (icons, colors, borders)
avoid_when: You need complex state‑management or animation beyond basic customization
Your app relies on a full UI kit and you prefer a more integrated solution
strengths: Supports both chip creation and selection in one package
Works on all Flutter platforms (mobile, web, desktop)
weaknesses: Limited to chip functionality, no built‑in state management
May require manual handling of selected values
